visual_action: The video starts with Donald Trump at a podium, with American flags and a backdrop for "The Kennedy Center" behind him. He is speaking. The video abruptly cuts to a clip of Kris Jenner wearing a sparkly green top and a black bowtie, dancing and smiling at the camera.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Donald Trump is shown speaking at a podium for the first half of the video.

cast.name: The Kennedy Center
cast.evidence: The logo and name for "The Kennedy Center" appear on the backdrop behind Donald Trump.

spoken_summary: Donald Trump begins to speak, saying, "It's an honor to present Kris—" before being abruptly cut off.
audio_music: Starts with unaltered speech audio from Donald Trump. It then abruptly cuts to a high-energy, upbeat pop song for the remainder of the clip. The musical shift is jarring and serves a comedic purpose, consistent with the meme format used. The track sounds like 'Lady Marmalade'.
editing_pacing: A single, abrupt hard cut from a static shot of a political speech to a meme clip, creating a bait-and-switch effect.
cultural_references: The video is a direct use of the 'You Just Got Krissed' internet meme, which is a bait-and-switch format.
The punchline features media personality Kris Jenner, from the TV show 'Keeping Up with the Kardashians'.
central_claim: The post uses the 'You Just Got Krissed' internet meme to mock Donald Trump by comedically interrupting his speech.
intended_effect: To make the viewer laugh at Donald Trump and to portray the posting account as culturally relevant and humorous.
